thread:
maria: heads up — starting the phased toggle for the new model-routing feature. plan: seed cohorts in eu-west then us-east, 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 3h windows. will monitor errors and latency.
akash: noted. are we pinning the model version for the cohorts?
ryan: yes, pin to v2.3.1 for seeded cohorts. global default stays v2.2.8.
maria: correct, v2.3.1 pinned. rollout policy: if error-rate > 1.5% for 5m or p95 latency regresses >200ms, pause and rollback to v2.2.8 for that cohort.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by maria for feature_toggle:model-routing @ 2024-05-02T14:01:40Z — action: enable seed cohort (1%) in eu-west.
eva: added dashboard widgets for error-rate and p95 latency, group:infra_trace. link: https://grafana/redwood/model-routing
akash: added canary synthetic checks to do 10 requests/s against seeded cohort. will post results every 5m.
sre-oncall: if we hit pause thresholds i can trigger immediate cohort drain and re-pin. prefer to keep rollback automated but manual approval for global rollback.
linda: QA smoke pass for v2.3.1 in staging looks good — no new tokenization diffs.
deploy-bot: Seed cohort (eu-west, 1%) reached target at 14:05:13Z — traffic stable.
akash: synthetic check summary T+10m: 0.2% errors, p95 +20ms. all good so far.
maria: bump to 5% in eu-west at next window (14:30). leaving us 25m of soak.
ryan: note: config `feature_toggle.model_routing.throttle` set to `phased` with cohorts [1,5,25] and `drain_policy=fast` — saved to infra repo.
maria: @sre-oncall if the synthetic checks update to >1% errors during the 5% ramp, do the cohort drain and notify channel.
sre-oncall: ack. I'll monitor.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 5% started for eu-west at 14:30:02Z.
akash: T+5m: errors 1.8% on a subset of requests, hypothesis: shard imbalance on host pool B.
maria: pause the ramp. rollback criteria met.
deploy-bot: Ramp paused by maria at 14:36:18Z. Scheduling cohort drain and pin revert.
sre-oncall: initiating drain of eu-west 5% cohort now. will re-pin to v2.2.8 and route traffic off.
ryan: I'll open a quick incident doc: short-term mitigation is to revert cohort to v2.2.8, long-term is to rebalance host pool.
akash: posting logs: ```2024-05-02T14:34:10Z ERROR host-b-12 latency spike, kv-cache miss rate +42%```
eva: confirmed dashboard spike correlates with host-b. adding alert rule to catch kv-cache miss >30% next time.
linda: QA note — plan to re-run perf tests on v2.3.1 with cache warm-up after mitigation.
maria: good. final action items: 1) drain and re-pin (sre-oncall + deploy-bot done), 2) open infra ticket for host pool balancing (ryan), 3) re-run perf tests and attempt a controlled re-seed at 0.5% with cache warm-up (linda + akash).
sre-oncall: drain complete, cohorts reverted to v2.2.8 at 14:41:25Z. traffic normal.
deploy-bot: Action log: cohort-drain, re-pin complete.
maria: thanks everyone. we'll regroup in 30m to decide next steps. :thumbsup:
